releases.intro: TF2Tools now comes in German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese and Russian (preview), installs maps straight from GameBanana, and lets a profile hold your whole setup. It also brings a first preview of the Demo Viewer, which flies you around a demo's map in 3D, and our first outside contribution: thanks @mrampazz for the HUD card fix!

releases.intro: TF2Tools 6.1 adds a Graphics page for mastercomfig, a logs.tf page with your stats and your teammates', GameBanana maps on the Maps page and add-ons in the Addon Store, plus a long list of HUD Maker and store fixes.

items.text: Crosshairs no longer stop weapons from firing. After the latest TF2 update, a weapon with a custom crosshair could not shoot. Press Apply on the Crosshairs page once after updating to fix your weapons.
New Maps page: search the community maps on serveme.tf and download one with a click. TF2Tools only removes maps it downloaded itself.
Edit an installed HUD in the HUD Maker straight from its card.
HUD Maker: zoom and pan the preview, drop a PNG onto the maker, and many previews now match the game more closely.
Built-in title bar with the app icon, and each store's icon in its download ring.
Pages remember where you were: the stores, the Activity Log, searches and unsaved edits stay when you switch pages.
One sound player for the whole app.
Name clashes keep both items: importing a HUD or crosshair with a taken name adds "(2)" instead of replacing it.
Profiles: Install Anyway leaves skipped items installed, and a profile can't take a name another profile already has.
Windows: TF2Tools 6 offers to remove the old TF2Tools 4.
Store pictures: every GameBanana screenshot now shows, with its position under the carousel.
Scrollbars on every page and list that scrolls, tooltips on every icon button, and plainer wording throughout.

releases.intro: TF2Tools 6.0.2 fixes custom crosshairs stopping weapons from firing after the latest TF2 update, and adds a Maps page for downloading community maps. It also brings a built-in window title bar and many smaller fixes across the app.

items.text: A new app: TF2Tools now runs as a regular desktop app on Windows and Linux, with no browser engine inside.
HUDs: keep all your HUDs in one library and switch with one click. TF2Tools offers to install any fonts a HUD needs.
HUD Store: the hand-picked list from hud-db, or everything on GameBanana.
Hitsounds and killsounds: add your own or download them from the Sound Store, and play them in the app before you pick.
A crosshair for every weapon: go class by class and give each weapon one of TF2's crosshairs, an image of your own or one from the Crosshair Store.
mastercomfig addons: install them from the Addon Store and get updates when mastercomfig releases new ones.
Crosshair Maker: draw your own crosshair pixel by pixel, with a preview over a map.
HUD Maker: see your HUD the way the game draws it, then move, resize, recolour or hide any part of it.
Profiles: save your HUD, sounds and crosshairs together and switch your whole setup at once.
Updates: TF2Tools checks for new versions and installs them itself on Windows and with the AppImage.

releases.intro: The first release of TF2Tools 6: TF2Tools rebuilt from the ground up as a native desktop app. It replaces TF2Tools 4, which ran inside a web browser engine, and is lighter and quicker to use. Everything below is new since TF2Tools 4.8.0.
